description: This file defines a PHP class 'Image_Graph_Plot_Smoothed_Radar' that extends 'Image_Graph_Plot_Smoothed_Bezier' to render smoothed radar charts using Bezier curves. It includes a method '_done' that handles drawing the plot on a canvas, including control point calculations and spline additions.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Plot_Smoothed_Radar
classes.description: A class for rendering smoothed radar charts with Bezier curves in the Image_Graph PHP library.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Handles rendering the radar plot by creating spline curves between dataset points, managing control points, and drawing on the canvas.
